name: Vinpearl Resort & Spa Nha Trang Bay
tagline: A seaside escape where holidays come to life
description: On the "paradise island" of Hon Tre, Vinpearl Resort & Spa Nha Trang Bay is always eye catching with its white bow-shaped architecture and distinctive pure vibe. Located behind the colorful bougainvillea roads, Vinpearl Resort & Spa Nha Trang Bay welcomes guests with a beautiful private beach, a large outdoor swimming pool and tailor-made services for a relaxing family vacation. Each room has a typical vivid sea view at dawn. Looking out into the distance, on one side is the iconic silhouette of the Sky Wheel and the fairy-tale shapes of the VinWonders castle, and on the other side is the pristine coastal city of Nha Trang waking up in the early morning sun at the end of the horizon.
